description.value:
Earth-Style Wall. You drag a wall of compressed earth from the ground in a 20-foot line within 30 feet of you. The wall is 10 feet tall, 5 feet thick, and lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss it.

Each 5-foot segment has Hardness 10, HP 40, and BT 20. The wall provides standard cover (or greater cover from a kneeling position) and blocks line of sight for non-flying creatures.

Heightened (4th) Hardness becomes 15, HP 60. The wall can be shaped into an L or T configuration.

system.requirements: exposed earth or stone within range
